Definition: from G53; cleanness (the state), i.e. (figuratively) blamelessness:--pureness.
BiblicalUsage: hagnótēs means pureness. In 2 Corinthians 6:6, the text says "By pureness."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hagnótēs as it stands: pureness.
